title: Policy leaderboard
description: Reported performance of the evaluated persona-conditioned policy configurations.

boards.title: Stage 2 · strict-success leaderboard
boards.description: 100 tasks · 217 authored persona cases · privileged state and goals · assisted skills · no RGB
notes: Success requires the native persona goal, physical nonfixture evidence, valid and faithful execution, no timeout and no controller error.
Trials are averaged within observed personas, personas within each task, and all 100 tasks equally. Infrastructure outcomes remain unscored.
Trial counts, reasoning effort, budgets, harness revisions and recovery procedures differ; ordering is descriptive.
Point estimates follow the CVPR 2027 Stage 2 table (paper commit 7bbb55c, 2026-11-17). Study protocols, coverage and archived count evidence are available in the downloadable results.

rows.protocol: Medium reasoning · 3 trials/persona · seeds 100–102 · 651 trials · 64 assisted actions
rows.notes: Rule A 32.89% / Rule B 31.22%; persona gap 19.3 / 22.0 pp. Fable uses three seeds per persona while the other execution cohorts use ten.

rows.protocol: Medium reasoning · 10 trials/persona · seeds 100–109 · Argon execution · 64 assisted actions
rows.notes: Rule A 32.49% / Rule B 31.19%; persona gap 20.9 / 19.7 pp. The composition analysis pairs Carbon inference with Argon execution as Gemini*; the earlier figure-only 30.4% point is retained in the downloadable evidence.

rows.protocol: High effort · 10 trials/persona · seeds 100–109 · Messages API · up to 10 decisions / 64 skills
rows.notes: 682 strict successes / 2,050 scored; 120 infrastructure slots are unscored. Three personas have no scored trials and are excluded from observed means. This interface is retained from the archived strict evidence; the CVPR Stage 2 table reports the CLI interface.

rows.protocol: High effort · 10 trials/persona · seeds 100–109 · Claude Code · tools disabled · up to 10 decisions / 64 skills
rows.notes: Rule A 31.20% / Rule B 30.30%; persona gap 19.0 / 18.8 pp. Archived counts: 668 strict successes / 2,138 scored; 32 infrastructure slots are unscored and all 217 personas have at least one scored trial.

rows.protocol: High reasoning · 10 trials/persona · seeds 100–109 · Codex CLI · 64 assisted actions
rows.notes: Rule A 30.23% / Rule B 29.73%; persona gap 19.7 / 19.5 pp. Pooled archive: 651 historical seed-100–102 records plus 1,519 CPU-continuation seed-103–109 records. The earlier 33.2% point on 651 trials is retained in the downloadable evidence.

rows.protocol: Medium reasoning · 1 trial/persona · seed 100 · Codex CLI · 64 assisted actions
rows.notes: 59 strict successes / 217 scored. Separate single-seed pilot with disclosed runtime recovery and a launch-budget exception; not part of the CVPR Stage 2 table.

rows.protocol: High effort · 10 trials/persona · seeds 100–109 · Responses-compatible API · 5 requests / 64 skills · 150 simulated seconds
rows.notes: Rule A 14.85% / Rule B 14.70%; persona gap 11.4 / 11.3 pp. 318 strict successes / 2,170 scored; the 1,099 policy errors count as failures and scored coverage does not imply simulator completion.

boards.title: Stage 1 · persona recall gap
boards.description: 100 tasks · 217 task-local personas · 200,000 planned decisions per model · five model families
notes: The gap is the mean within-task range of persona recall: higher values mean the policy falls back to stronger task-dependent defaults.
Hard-tier agreement sits near the 47.25% uniform-choice reference for every model, so the informative contrast is the recall gap rather than headline accuracy.
Easy-tier contextual accuracy spans 98.32–100.00%; an ideal uniform selector has zero expected population recall gap.

rows.notes: Astra combines 897 verified historical-import batches with 1,103 new Codex CLI/low batches and retains both configuration segments.
Fable matches the easy tier but keeps a large default-driven gap on unidentifiable HRI.
Opus records the lowest easy-tier contextual accuracy of the five families and a large hard-tier gap.
DeepSeek preserves the smallest gap of the five cohorts while matching the others on overall agreement.
Gemini Carbon/CLI records the smallest hard-tier recall gap with near-perfect easy-tier filtering.

provenance.evidenceSnapshot: Derived counts are included in the public downloadable data; access to the private paper source is not required to inspect these counts.
provenance.sourceMethod: Displayed point estimates follow the CVPR 2027 Stage 2 and Stage 1 tables at the named paper revision. Five archived strict report files were SHA-256-verified and their success counts and task-balanced means independently recomputed as archived evidence. Those archive checks do not independently recompute the paper's revised Astra, Gemini or Fable points; no matching current trial-count bundle is included for the table-only points.
provenance.definition: Native persona-goal success, physical nonfixture evidence, valid and faithful execution, no timeout and no controller error. Scored policy errors fail.
provenance.aggregation: Mean observed trials within each observed persona, then mean observed personas within each task, then mean of all 100 tasks. This differs from pooled episode success.
provenance.missingData: Infrastructure errors remain unscored. Three entirely unobserved Opus API personas are excluded from the conditional task means; all 100 tasks have some observed data.
provenance.rounding: Paper-display percentages are rounded to one decimal using decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; full precision and rational rates remain in evidence.
provenance.scoreMeaning: These are complete privileged assisted policy systems, not raw vision-only model inference.
provenance.sourceDescription: CVPR 2027 Stage 2 strict-success leaderboard (Astra 30.23, Gemini Argon 32.49, Opus CLI 31.20, Fable 32.89, DeepSeek 14.85) plus the Stage 1 persona recall gap. The private source is identified by its immutable revision and table; archived trial counts retain their own provenance.
